summary: General Catalyst Global Resilience Merger Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K on June 16, 2026, announcing that holders of its GRAIL securities may elect to separately trade the underlying Class A ordinary shares and warrants starting June 22, 2026. Each GRAIL security consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-fourth of one redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50. The securities are listed on Nasdaq: GRAIL units (GCGRU), shares (GCGR), and warrants (GCGRW). No fractional warrants will be issued. Holders must contact Continental Stock Transfer to separate. This optional separation is a standard post-IPO milestone for SPAC units. No premium, price, or board recommendation is stated. What to watch: trading volumes upon separation and any subsequent business combination announcement.
